name: Nationality by Descent

qualifying_event.description: Under Oman's Nationality Law (Royal Decree 38/2014, replacing RD 3/1983), a child born to an Omani father automatically acquires Omani nationality. A child born to an Omani mother acquires nationality only where the father is unknown or paternity is not legally established -- there is no automatic maternal-line transmission where the father is a known, acknowledged foreign national.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; father's proof of Omani nationality (paternal-line cases); for maternal-line cases, evidence that the father is unknown or paternity is unestablished.

requirements.blocker_text: Automatic Omani nationality for a child born to an Omani father, regardless of the mother's nationality.

requirement_groups.name: Child of an Omani mother, father unknown/unproven

requirements.blocker_text: A child born to an Omani mother acquires Omani nationality only if the father is unknown or paternity has not been legally established -- not available where the child has a known, acknowledged foreign father.

sources.title: Decree.om -- a legal-commentary blog specializing in Omani law, summarizing the nationality-by-descent rules under Royal Decree 38/2014: paternal-line automatic transmission, maternal-line transmission only where the father is unknown/unproven, and the 2023 Royal Decree 23/2023 change removing mandatory government pre-approval of Omani-foreigner marriages
Commoner Law -- corroborates paternal-line automatic descent and cites Royal Decree 38/2014 (replacing RD 3/1983) as the current governing nationality law
